name: CENNETIC Z300 High-Rigidity 5-Axis Machining Center
summary: The Z300 is a high-rigidity 5-axis machining center for accurate multi-axis machining of structural and prismatic parts in a single setup.
body:
The Z300 is a high-rigidity 5-axis machining center for accurate multi-axis machining of structural and prismatic parts in a single setup.

About this model

This 5-Axis Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
